ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels; white pixels are predominantly concentrated at the distal lobe tips and as scattered focal points, while dark pixels occupy the central 70% of the fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity contiguous blobs are mapped to the distal 15% of both left and right lobes. A vertical white rectangular patch is located at the center-bottom notch interface. The remaining medial areas consist of low-intensity dark fields populated by a high-density stochastic distribution of white focal spots (approx. 2-10 pixels in diameter).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 68 degrees and a narrow vertex point at the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous linear boundary. The right lobe trailing edge displays larger amplitude peaks (approx. 12-18 pixels) compared to the left lobe, creating a more jagged profile towards the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep from the median notch towards the distal tips, terminating in sharp, high-intensity points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters at the extreme distal margins. Numerous smaller circular high-intensity constellations are distributed across the dark pigmentation of the medial lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions (white rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, positioned approximately 25% of the distance from the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular jagged trauma marks along the trailing edge serrations; distinct linear rake marks localized on the right lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'starry' pigmentation pattern characterized by a high frequency of small-diameter high-intensity focal points across the dark central fluke body.
